note: REM PhysicalAI is one system for many robots. It starts at the camera: it detects the robot in view, knows which robot it is, and then — if it can control that robot, it controls it; if it cannot, it dreams about it and trains it virtually, in simulation.

projects.control_label: full control — it commands the body through the Bridge (LED matrix, servos)
projects.dream: Dreams with its pose model: standing, walking, fallen, flipped.
projects.name: WalkerSense
projects.what: The host body living on this very board — an ODC body with the Ventuno Q as its brain.

projects.control_label: dream only — it cannot control this robot, so it dreams about it and trains it virtually
projects.dream: Its physics twin lives on the dream stage: the system rehearses with the twin and learns there.
projects.name: PuppyPi
projects.what: The robot dog in front of the camera at this event — another team's robot; this system cannot drive it.
